svg.title: Narrow actual CAD front and side dimensions at one scale

g.text: Narrow source CAD: front and side at the same scale
2pixels/mm. External products shown; internal loom is in the native model and its full fit record.
Red: nominal pendant CG and fixed-position mass-allowance interval. Blue: suspension / service bound.
Conditional nominal hanging tilt 11.90deg; mass-only interval 9.02 to 15.06deg.
Free necklace span is laid clear for service. Full human hand, strap twist and supplied tolerances are not bounded.
Physical fit, mass, strength and wearing angle are unmeasured. Optical colours here are diagram-only.
